items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q:

night.
But if there's a band there or even

I've played along with some of the
greats. In fact, when Bill first gave me the horn,
I was booked to appear on a concert in which Clark
Terry was on along with other guys.

And Bill had just given me the horn
about a week before. And he was at the concert and
he was anxious to see the expression on Clark
Terry's face when I turn around with this horn.
